caption: The drawing depicts a single object—a jug with a rounded body, a wide spout, and an ornate handle. The jug rests on a circular base with a raised lip and features a broad, bulbous midsection that narrows towards both the top and bottom. The handle is attached to the upper section and has an elegant, flowing shape with a decorative detail near its lower attachment point. The object is rendered in shades of light gray and beige, with subtle shading to indicate volume and depth. The background is plain and off-white, with a faint border drawn around the composition. In the bottom right corner, the name "JANET RIZA" is printed in small capital letters.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
